name: perl-json-create
description: This tool encodes Perl data structures into JSON format with a focus on speed and UTF-8 output. Use when user asks to convert Perl variables to JSON, handle boolean values in JSON output, or serialize Perl objects using TO_JSON methods.
overview: The `perl-json-create` skill provides a streamlined interface for encoding Perl variables into JSON format. It is designed for speed and simplicity, focusing strictly on UTF-8 output. This tool is ideal for backend Perl scripts, API development, or data processing pipelines where performance and memory footprint are prioritized over complex configuration options.
